    (SELECT c.customerid, c.segment, y.consumption

WHERE segment1.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')

SELECT 
    segment1 AS segment_a,
    segment2 AS segment_b,
    AVG(consumption_a) - AVG(consumption_b) AS avg_consumption_difference
FROM (
    SELECT 
        c1.segment AS segment1,
        c2.segment AS segment2,
        y1.consumption AS consumption_a,
        y2.consumption AS consumption_b
    FROM 
        yearmonth y1
    JOIN 
        customers c1 ON y1.customerid = c1.customerid
    JOIN 
        transactions_1k t1 ON y1.customerid = t1.customerid
    JOIN 
        gasstations g1 ON t1.gasstationid = g1.gasstationid
    JOIN 
        yearmonth y2 ON y1.customerid = y2.customerid
    JOIN 
        customers c2 ON y2.customerid = c2.customerid
    JOIN 
        transactions_1k t2 ON y2.customerid = t2.customerid
    JOIN 
        gasstations g2 ON t2.gasstationid = g2.gasstationid
    WHERE 
        c1.currency = 'CZK' AND 
        c2.currency = 'CZK' AND 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.date) = 2013 AND 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t2.date) = 2013 AND 
        c1.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND 
        c2.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND 
        c1.segment <> c2.segment
) AS subquery
GROUP BY 
    segment1, segment2	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing

SELECT segment1, segment2, AVG(consumption_diff) AS avg_consumption_diff
FROM (
    SELECT 
        c1.segment AS segment1,
        c2.segment AS segment2,
        y1.customerid,
        y1.consumption - y2.consumption AS consumption_diff
    FROM (
        SELECT y.customerid, y.consumption, c.segment
        FROM yearmonth y
        JOIN customers c ON y.customerid = c.customerid
        JOIN transactions_1k t ON y.customerid = t.customerid
        WHERE c.currency = 'CZK' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.date) = 2013
        GROUP BY y.customerid, c.segment, y.consumption
        ORDER BY y.consumption ASC
        LIMIT 1
    ) y1
    JOIN (
        SELECT y.customerid, y.consumption, c.segment
        FROM yearmonth y
        JOIN customers c ON y.customerid = c.customerid
        JOIN transactions_1k t ON y.customerid = t.customerid
        WHERE c.currency = 'CZK' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.date) = 2013
        GROUP BY y.customerid, c.segment, y.consumption
        ORDER BY y.consumption ASC
        LIMIT 1
    ) y2 ON y1.customerid = y2.customerid
    JOIN customers c1 ON y1.customerid = c1.customerid
    JOIN customers c2 ON y2.customerid = c2.customerid
    WHERE c1.segment <> c2.segment
) AS consumption_diffs
GROUP BY segment1, segment2	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing
